text: Future product vision. Platform access is permission-based and varies by operating system. Android supports user-selected call screening and permissioned notification access; iOS uses Call Directory / Live Caller ID and Message Filter extensions; Gmail requires account authorization. Sources: https://developer.android.com/reference/android/telecom/CallScreeningService, https://developer.android.com/reference/android/service/notification/NotificationListenerService, https://developer.apple.com/documentation/IdentityLookup, https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/push
